spans.title: The Swapped Composition
spans.blurb: A schoolgirl trades her clever composition for a friend's dull one, then watches the exchange unravel in front of the whole school.

spans.title: A Girl as Good as a Boy
spans.blurb: After her brother's death, an eleven-year-old girl vows to be everything a son could be: Greek before breakfast, fences on horseback, all to earn one sentence from her father.

books.pairNote: Two separate childhood episodes from the same memoir; no shared text or payoff.

spans.title: I'll Try This Case Myself
spans.blurb: A mild-seeming judge starts asking questions nobody expects, and two shyster lawyers and a crooked policeman feel the courtroom floor tilt under them.
spans.spoilerNote: Shows the courtroom collapse of the frame-up against Tony, which is the payoff of one story in the collection.

spans.title: The Sugar Corner
spans.blurb: Three hundred picked men wait for the gong on the Exchange floor. The calmest face in the middle of the mob is about to set the market on fire.

spans.title: The Drum of the Sands
spans.blurb: Crossing a sea of burning sand, a caravan halts: somewhere among the dunes an invisible drum begins to roll, and the guides whisper of death.

spans.title: An Uncomfortable Bed
spans.blurb: A guest at a chateau full of practical jokers lies awake certain a prank is coming, and takes elaborate precautions against every trick he can imagine.

books.pairNote: Two unrelated tales from the anthology; nothing shared.

spans.title: The Hair of Gold
spans.blurb: A knight lands disguised in a hostile country, fights a fire-breathing dragon alone, and wakes to find his life in the hands of the woman he came to win.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals the hero's hidden identity as the Morholt's slayer and how he wins the princess from the false seneschal, an early staged discovery of the legend.

spans.title: Footsteps on the Stair
spans.blurb: Alone at night by his open door, a student hears boots climbing the spiral staircase toward him, loud and close, long before anyone comes into view.

spans.title: The Search at Midnight
spans.blurb: A man and his elderly aunt search an empty house at midnight, room by room and floor by floor, and the house begins to answer back.

books.pairNote: Drawn from two different ghost stories in the collection; nothing shared.

spans.title: The Knock in the Blizzard
spans.blurb: Midnight, a howling blizzard, and a pounding at the front door. A small-town couple in their nightclothes argue over who has to answer it.

spans.title: Errour's Den
spans.blurb: Warned by his lady and begged by his dwarf to fly, a young knight walks into a monster's den anyway, his glimmering armor the only light.

spans.title: Hooked
spans.blurb: An angler swerves politely around a rival's cast at dusk and takes the fly in his ear. The stranger holding the rod is not what he expected.

spans.title: Put Off in the Rain
spans.blurb: A conductor demands a fare she has already paid. The girl refuses, the rain roars down, and a stranger's gloved hand starts gathering her scattered note-books.
